# ZEECOM SOLUTION

> ZEECOM SOLUTION is an enterprise technology infrastructure and systems engineering firm providing turnkey AI physical security, VoIP integrated CRM contact center telephony, and IP-Audio mass notification systems.

For complete architectural details, see our [Full Technical Reference](https://zeecomsolution.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Capabilities & Solutions

- [AI-Powered Surveillance & Access Control](https://zeecomsolution.com/ai-surveillance-access-control): Edge AI computer vision, 4K optical analytics, biometric facial authentication, touchless entry, and multi-site unified security command.
- [VoIP Integrated CRM & Contact Center](https://zeecomsolution.com/voip-crm-contact-center): High-availability SIP telephony, instant CRM screen pops, one-click dialing, call recording, IVR queues, and omnichannel messaging.
- [IP-Audio & Public Address Systems](https://zeecomsolution.com/ip-audio-pa-systems): Multi-zone IP network audio, PoE power, two-way intercoms, and ONVIF/SIP emergency paging broadcast.

## Interactive Tools & Simulators

- [AI Solutions Architect](https://zeecomsolution.com/#ai-architect): Dynamic capacity planner and bill-of-materials (BOM) generator for enterprise infrastructure.
- [System Configurator](https://zeecomsolution.com/#configurator): Live multi-zone security, telephony, and audio deployment designer with real-time budget forecasting.

## Company & Contact Information

- [Official Website](https://zeecomsolution.com): Primary portal for enterprise solutions and technical specifications.
